SELECT * FROM EQUITY_CHANGE_RECORD
ORDER BY CHANGE_DATE DESC, UPDATE_TIME DESC
LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{pageNumber}
OFFSET #{pageNumber} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{pageSize} ROWS ONLY

SELECT INVESTEE_ENTERPRISE_ID as enterpriseId, INVESTEE_ENTERPRISE_NAME as enterpriseName, COUNT(*) as changeCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CHANGE_TYPE) as changeTypeCount, MAX(CHANGE_DATE) as lastChangeDate FROM EQUITY_CHANGE_RECORD WHERE CHANGE_DATE >=
DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY)
SYSDATE - #{days}
GROUP BY INVESTEE_ENTERPRISE_ID, INVESTEE_ENTERPRISE_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) >= #{minChangeCount} ORDER BY changeCount DESC

SELECT
DATE_FORMAT(CHANGE_DATE, '%Y-%m') as period,
TO_CHAR(CHANGE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM') as period,
COUNT(*) as count, COUNT(DISTINCT INVESTEE_ENTERPRISE_ID) as enterpriseCount, SUM(CASE WHEN IS_MAJOR_CHANGE = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as majorChangeCount, SUM(CASE WHEN NEED_WARNING = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as warningCount FROM EQUITY_CHANGE_RECORD WHERE 1=1
AND CHANGE_DATE >= #{startDate}
AND CHANGE_DATE <= #{endDate}
GROUP BY
DATE_FORMAT(CHANGE_DATE, '%Y-%m')
TO_CHAR(CHANGE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM')
ORDER BY period

SELECT
DATE_FORMAT(CHANGE_DATE, '%Y-%m') as period,
TO_CHAR(CHANGE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM') as period,
SUM(CHANGE_AMOUNT) as totalAmount, AVG(CHANGE_AMOUNT) as avgAmount, MAX(CHANGE_AMOUNT) as maxAmount, MIN(CHANGE_AMOUNT) as minAmount FROM EQUITY_CHANGE_RECORD WHERE CHANGE_AMOUNT IS NOT NULL
AND CHANGE_DATE >= #{startDate}
AND CHANGE_DATE <= #{endDate}
GROUP BY
DATE_FORMAT(CHANGE_DATE, '%Y-%m')
TO_CHAR(CHANGE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM')
ORDER BY period

UPDATE EQUITY_CHANGE_RECORD SET NEED_WARNING = #{needWarning}, WARNING_LEVEL = #{warningLevel}, UPDATE_TIME = NOW() SYSDATE WHERE CHANGE_ID IN
#{changeId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) as totalChanges, COUNT(DISTINCT INVESTEE_ENTERPRISE_ID) as affectedEnterprises, SUM(CASE WHEN IS_MAJOR_CHANGE = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as majorChanges, SUM(CASE WHEN NEED_WARNING = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as warningChanges, SUM(CASE WHEN APPROVAL_STATUS = 'PENDING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as pendingApprovals, SUM(CASE WHEN APPROVAL_STATUS = 'APPROVED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as approvedChanges, SUM(CHANGE_AMOUNT) as totalChangeAmount, AVG(CHANGE_AMOUNT) as avgChangeAmount FROM EQUITY_CHANGE_RECORD

SELECT CHANGE_TYPE as type, COUNT(*) as count, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EQUITY_CHANGE_RECORD), 2) as percentage FROM EQUITY_CHANGE_RECORD GROUP BY CHANGE_TYPE ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT CHANGE_REASON as reason, COUNT(*) as count, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EQUITY_CHANGE_RECORD), 2) as percentage FROM EQUITY_CHANGE_RECORD GROUP BY CHANGE_REASON ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT APPROVAL_STATUS as status, COUNT(*) as count, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EQUITY_CHANGE_RECORD), 2) as percentage FROM EQUITY_CHANGE_RECORD GROUP BY APPROVAL_STATUS ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT WARNING_LEVEL as level, COUNT(*) as count, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EQUITY_CHANGE_RECORD WHERE NEED_WARNING = 1), 2) as percentage FROM EQUITY_CHANGE_RECORD WHERE NEED_WARNING = 1 GROUP BY WARNING_LEVEL ORDER BY CASE WARNING_LEVEL WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 1 WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 2 WHEN 'MEDIUM' THEN 3 WHEN 'LOW' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END

SELECT CHANGE_ID as changeId, INVESTEE_ENTERPRISE_NAME as investeeEnterpriseName, INVESTOR_ENTERPRISE_NAME as investorEnterpriseName, CHANGE_TYPE as changeType, CHANGE_REASON as changeReason, CHANGE_DATE as changeDate, CHANGE_AMOUNT as changeAmount, BEFORE_SHAREHOLDING_RATIO as beforeShareholdingRatio, AFTER_SHAREHOLDING_RATIO as afterShareholdingRatio, APPROVAL_STATUS as approvalStatus, IS_MAJOR_CHANGE as isMajorChange, NEED_WARNING as needWarning, WARNING_LEVEL as warningLevel FROM EQUITY_CHANGE_RECORD
ORDER BY CHANGE_DATE DESC
